segments.text: Once upon a time there lived in a certain village a little country girl,
segments.translation: Era uma vez, em certa aldeia, uma menininha do campo,

segments.text: the prettiest creature who has ever seen.
segments.translation: a criatura mais linda que já se viu.

segments.text: Her mother was fond of her, and her grandmother doted on her still more.
segments.translation: Sua mãe gostava muito dela, e sua avó a adorava ainda mais.

segments.text: This good woman had a little red riding hood made for her.
segments.translation: Essa boa senhora mandou fazer para ela um capuzinho vermelho.

pt.text: mandou fazer para ela um capuzinho vermelho

segments.text: It suited the girl so extremely well
segments.translation: Ele caía tão bem na menina

segments.text: that everybody called her little red riding hood.
segments.translation: que todos a chamavam de Chapeuzinho Vermelho.

segments.text: One day her mother made some cakes and said to her,
segments.translation: Um dia, sua mãe fez uns bolos e lhe disse:

segments.text: Go, my dear, and see how your grandmother is doing,
segments.translation: Vá, minha querida, ver como está sua avó,

segments.text: because she has been very ill.
segments.translation: porque ela tem estado muito doente.

segments.text: Take her a cake and this little pot of butter.
segments.translation: Leve para ela um bolo e este potinho de manteiga.

segments.text: Little Red Riding had set out immediately to go to her grandmother,
segments.translation: Chapeuzinho Vermelho partiu imediatamente para a casa da avó,

segments.text: who lived in another village.
segments.translation: que morava em outra aldeia.

segments.text: As she was going through the wood,
segments.translation: Quando atravessava o bosque,

segments.text: she met with a wolf
segments.translation: ela encontrou um lobo

segments.text: who had a very great mind to eat her up,
segments.translation: que estava com muita vontade de devorá-la,

segments.text: but he dared not because of some woodcutters working nearby in the forest.
segments.translation: mas não se atreveu, por causa de uns lenhadores que trabalhavam ali perto, na floresta.

segments.text: He asked her where she was going.
segments.translation: Ele perguntou aonde ela ia.

segments.text: The poor child, who did not know
segments.translation: A pobre criança, que não sabia

segments.text: that it was dangerous to stay and talk to a wolf,
segments.translation: que era perigoso parar e conversar com um lobo,

segments.text: said to him, I am going to see my grandmother
segments.translation: disse a ele: Vou ver a minha avó

segments.text: and carry her a cake and a little pot of butter for my mother.
segments.translation: e levar para ela um bolo e um potinho de manteiga, da parte da minha mãe.

segments.text: Does she live far off?
segments.translation: Ela mora longe?

segments.text: said the wolf.
segments.translation: disse o lobo.

segments.text: Oh, I say, answered little red riding hood,
segments.translation: Ah, sim, respondeu Chapeuzinho Vermelho,

segments.text: it is beyond that mill you see there,
segments.translation: fica além daquele moinho que você vê ali,

segments.text: at the first house in the village.
segments.translation: na primeira casa da aldeia.

segments.text: Well, said the wolf, and I'll go and see her too.
segments.translation: Bem, disse o lobo, eu também vou vê-la.

segments.text: I'll go this way and go you that,
segments.translation: Eu vou por este caminho e você vai por aquele,

segments.text: and we shall see who will be there first.
segments.translation: e veremos quem chega lá primeiro.

segments.text: The wolf ran as fast as he could,
segments.translation: O lobo correu o mais rápido que pôde,

segments.text: taking the shortest path, and the little girl took a roundabout way,
segments.translation: pegando o caminho mais curto, e a menina foi por um caminho mais longo,

segments.text: entertaining herself by gathering nuts, running after butterflies,
segments.translation: distraindo-se em colher nozes, correr atrás de borboletas

segments.text: and gathering bouquets of little flowers.
segments.translation: e fazer buquês de florzinhas.

segments.text: It was not long before the wolf arrived at the old woman's house.
segments.translation: Não demorou muito para o lobo chegar à casa da velhinha.

segments.text: He knocked at the door. Tap, tap. Who's there?
segments.translation: Ele bateu à porta. Toc, toc. Quem é?

segments.text: Your grandchild, Little Red Riding Hood, replied the wolf,
segments.translation: Sua netinha, Chapeuzinho Vermelho, respondeu o lobo,

segments.text: counterfeiting her voice, who has brought you a cake
segments.translation: imitando a voz dela, que lhe trouxe um bolo

segments.text: and a little pot of butter sent you by mother.
segments.translation: e um potinho de manteiga que a mamãe mandou.

segments.text: The good grandmother, who was in bed because she was ill,
segments.translation: A boa avó, que estava de cama porque estava doente,

segments.text: cried out, Pull the bobbin, and the latch will go up.
segments.translation: gritou: Puxe a cordinha, e o trinco vai subir.

segments.text: The wolf pulled the bobbin, and the door opened,
segments.translation: O lobo puxou a cordinha, e a porta se abriu,

segments.text: and then he immediately fell upon the good woman
segments.translation: e então ele logo se atirou sobre a boa senhora

segments.text: and ate her up in a moment,
segments.translation: e a devorou num instante,

segments.text: for it had been more than three days since he had eaten.
segments.translation: pois fazia mais de três dias que ele não comia.

segments.text: He then shut the door and got into the grandmother's bed,
segments.translation: Depois ele fechou a porta e se deitou na cama da avó,

segments.text: expecting Little Red Riding Hood,
segments.translation: esperando Chapeuzinho Vermelho,

segments.text: who came some time afterwards and knocked at the door. Tap, tap. Who's there?
segments.translation: que chegou algum tempo depois e bateu à porta. Toc, toc. Quem é?

segments.text: Little Red Riding Hood,
segments.translation: Chapeuzinho Vermelho,

segments.text: hearing the big voice of the wolf, was at first afraid,
segments.translation: ao ouvir a voz grossa do lobo, a princípio ficou com medo,

segments.text: but believing her grandmother had a cold and was hoarse,
segments.translation: mas, achando que a avó estava resfriada e rouca,

segments.text: answered, It is your grandchild Little Red Riding Hood,
segments.translation: respondeu: É a sua netinha, Chapeuzinho Vermelho,

segments.text: who has brought you a cake
segments.translation: que lhe trouxe um bolo

segments.text: and a little pot of butter mother sends you.
segments.translation: e um potinho de manteiga que a mamãe lhe manda.

segments.text: The wolf cried out to her,
segments.translation: O lobo gritou para ela,

segments.text: softening his voice as much as he could,
segments.translation: suavizando a voz o quanto podia:

segments.text: Pull the bobbin, and the latch will go up.
segments.translation: Puxe a cordinha, e o trinco vai subir.

segments.text: Little Red Riding Hood pulled the bobbin, and the door opened.
segments.translation: Chapeuzinho Vermelho puxou a cordinha, e a porta se abriu.

segments.text: The wolf said to her, hiding himself under the bedclothes,
segments.translation: O lobo disse a ela, escondendo-se debaixo das cobertas:

segments.text: put the cake and the little pot of butter upon the stool
segments.translation: ponha o bolo e o potinho de manteiga em cima do banquinho

segments.text: and come get into bed with me.
segments.translation: e venha se deitar na cama comigo.

segments.text: Little Red Riding Hood took off her clothes and got into bed.
segments.translation: Chapeuzinho Vermelho tirou a roupa e se deitou na cama.

segments.text: She was greatly amazed to see how her grandmother looked in her nightclothes
segments.translation: Ela ficou muito espantada ao ver como a avó era de camisola

segments.text: and said to her, Grandmother, what big arms you have.
segments.translation: e disse a ela: Vovó, que braços grandes você tem!

segments.text: All the better to hug you with, my dear.
segments.translation: É para te abraçar melhor, minha querida.

segments.text: Grandmother, what big legs you have.
segments.translation: Vovó, que pernas grandes você tem!

segments.text: All the better to run with, my child.
segments.translation: É para correr melhor, minha criança.

segments.text: Grandmother What big ears you have
segments.translation: Vovó, que orelhas grandes você tem!

segments.text: All the better to hear with my child
segments.translation: É para ouvir melhor, minha criança.

segments.text: Grandmother What big eyes you have
segments.translation: Vovó, que olhos grandes você tem!

segments.text: All the better to see with my child
segments.translation: É para ver melhor, minha criança.

segments.text: Grandmother What big teeth you have got
segments.translation: Vovó, que dentes grandes você tem!

segments.text: All the better to eat you up with And,
segments.translation: É para te devorar melhor! E,

segments.text: saying these words This wicked wolf fell upon little red riding hood
segments.translation: dizendo essas palavras, esse lobo malvado se atirou sobre Chapeuzinho Vermelho

segments.text: And ate her all up The end
segments.translation: e a devorou inteirinha. Fim.
